title: agent context crashes uncaught on a qualified reference the bare bundle cannot resolve
description: Found live by opum-agent testing a workaround for LCLI-448's orchestration-profile finding: a profile pinning a qualified reference (member::path) and compiled BARE (no --workspace) crashed with an uncaught error_type 'undefined is not an object (evaluating concept.body)' instead of a clean, classified failure. Root cause: LCLI-432's validateAgentProfileReferences fix deliberately skips any ::-qualified reference (it is meaningful only under --workspace, validated there instead) -- but nothing re-validated one before the bare compile path (itemForReference/buildSourceCandidates in agent-context.ts) dereferenced graph.concepts.get(reference.conceptId) as Concept directly, assuming it could never be undefined. This is a real regression from the pre-LCLI-432 behavior, which at least produced a clean validation error for the same input. Fix: added requireConcept(), which first tries the bundle's own bare graph, then -- since a bare compile has exactly one bundle, so a qualifier can only ever mean this one -- falls back to stripping the member:: prefix and retrying, and only then throws a clean classified validation error naming the reference. This is also the enhancement opum-agent asked for: a profile that pins its own repository's docs with an explicit qualifier (needed so the SAME reference also resolves correctly under --workspace against a real fleet manifest) now works identically whether compiled bare or cross-repo, with no profile fork required.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a bare (non --workspace) compile of a profile with a qualified reference naming the CURRENT bundle resolves it against the bare graph, ignoring the qualifier
a bare compile of a profile with a qualified reference that still cannot resolve fails with a clean, classified validation LoreError, never an uncaught crash
workspace-mode resolution and provenance stamping are unaffected (the fallback never activates there, since every workspace reference is pre-validated before reaching this code)
regression tests pin both the successful bare-qualified-resolution case and the clean-failure case
full suite, typecheck, lint, and lore check all pass

finalSummary: Added requireConcept() in src/core/agent-context.ts, used at both graph.concepts.get(reference.conceptId) call sites (buildSourceCandidates, itemForReference). It tries the exact conceptId first (unchanged for every existing bare/workspace path -- both already guarantee resolution before reaching here), then for a ::-qualified id that still misses, strips the member:: prefix and retries against the same bare graph (a bare compile has exactly one bundle, so the qualifier can only ever mean that one), and only then throws a clean validation LoreError naming the reference -- never the prior uncaught 'undefined is not an object (evaluating concept.body)' crash. Verified live against the exact repro opum-agent hit: pinned = ["myrepo::reference/opum-agent-component-charter"] compiled bare now resolves cleanly (conceptId in the output is the bare id, reference stays as-authored); a reference that still does not exist fails with exit 6 and a proper message instead of an uncaught crash. 2 new tests in test/agent-profile.test.ts. Full suite 2854 pass/1 skip/0 fail, typecheck clean, lint clean, lore check 77 files/0 errors. CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] Fixed entry added.
